_comment: Copy to config.local.json (gitignored) and fill in. Get an API key at https://www.opensubtitles.com/en/consumers - free after registering.
_comment_login: Optional. Signing in raises the download allowance from 5/day to at least 10/day.
_comment_languages: Subtitle languages to search for, best first.
_comment_gloss: Study mode's word meanings, best tier first. gloss_model names a model that sees the subtitle line a word was said in, which is what tells "spare a minute" from "a spare tyre"; gloss_url defaults to a model running on this machine (http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1/chat/completions for ollama) and gloss_api_key is only needed for a hosted one. google_api_key is the tier below: a sane answer for a bare word, with no idea of the line. With neither, a free archive answers and the glosses are what they were. EMPTY gloss_model means the tier is off and Google answers everything - which is the setting to keep while the machine is busy, because a local model costs its whole size in memory and the machine is not only running this. See tools/gloss_bakeoff.py for what each candidate measured.
